column4: The petulant child threw a tantrum when he didn't get his way.
Her speech left a profound impact on everyone who heard it.
He has a propensity to overthink even simple decisions.
The smell coming from the garbage was utterly repugnant.
She remained reticent during the discussion, keeping her thoughts to herself.
Despite the challenges, she remained sanguine about her future.
He sought solace in his friends after the breakup.
The somber mood in the room reflected the tragic news.
Her temperamental nature made it difficult to work with her.
She approached the stage with trepidation, unsure of how the audience would react.
The truculent attitude of the customer made the situation worse.
She felt vicarious excitement watching her friend perform.
The wrath of the storm left a trail of destruction.
She accepted the invitation with alacrity.
The volcano had been dormant for decades before erupting again.
His ebullient personality made him the life of every gathering.
She faced the chaos with equanimity, staying calm throughout.
The hardy plants survived the harsh winter conditions.
His indolent behavior prevented him from achieving his goals.
The presentation was so insipid that half the audience fell asleep.
His comments instigated a heated argument among the group.
The lawyer invoked a precedent to strengthen her case.
His lackadaisical attitude towards his work frustrated his colleagues.
The laggard in the group held up the completion of the project.
After a long, hot day, she lay languid on the couch, too tired to move.
